title: A session's Overview now lists its child sessions, each with its own page

owner_note.text: The Overview is grouped by child session: e00f55c9 shows 102, its deputy 44, and the deputy's child 1, with no Chat tab on a child. Its rows still use their own markup instead of the shared task row; making them one component is queued.
